prompt:
Please use the attached full-body image of a person as a reference image for the character.
[Character]
For the person in the reference image, maintain their face, expression, hair, sense of age, body type, sense of height, head-to-body ratio, and full-body proportions as they are. Do not infer, correct, or redesign these from text, and consistently reflect the person visible in the reference image across all displays.

If the reference image is live-action, convert it into a high-quality anime expression without changing the character's features and full-body proportions. If the reference image is an illustration or anime, maintain the character modeling and drawing direction as they are, and do not change it to live-action or another style of drawing.

Costumes, shoes, accessories, jewelry, hair ornaments, belts, bags, poses, backgrounds, floors, and lighting from the reference image will not be inherited. Do not refer to the original costume or mix it with the following costume; replace it completely.

[Costume]
An off-the-shoulder, fit-and-flare A-line dress in deep ruby wine red that maintains brightness and vividness. Make it a color that clearly looks red, with a slight hint of Bordeaux, but not brown, black, or dark maroon. Arrange medium-sized ivory white polka dots evenly at wide intervals without making them crowded.

An off-the-shoulder neck that shows both shoulders and collarbones, short simple sleeves that run along the bottom of the shoulders, an upper body that naturally follows the body, a waist narrowed by sewing, and a symmetrical and smooth flared A-line. Do not use a belt. The hem should be on the lower thigh close to the knee, 8-10 cm above the knee, and not a mini-length at the center of the thigh. Provide safety shorts of the same color on the inside, but do not show them in a standing posture. Do not use ruffles, puff sleeves, ribbons, jackets, separate tops, wrap structures, pleats, or asymmetrical structures.

Shoes are deep ruby wine red in the same color as the dress. Closed-toe T-strap shoes, not-too-thin almond toes, thin vertical straps, thin ankle straps, 2-3 cm low block heels, and small silver buckles. No sneakers, lace-ups, thick athletic soles, open toes, sandals, or high heels.

[Layout]
Generate one highly designed character style sheet in a 1:1 square at the highest resolution selectable.

In the upper approximately 65%, place a three-view full-body view of the same person in a horizontal row. Left is the front full body with the heading "01 FRONT", center is the complete side full body with the heading "02 SIDE", and right is the back full body with the heading "03 BACK". Align them with the same floor baseline, character size, camera distance, viewpoint height, and natural upright posture, and display them from the top of the head to the soles of the shoes without cutting them off.

The three-view drawing is a display of the same person rotated under the same conditions. Do not change the face, hair, sense of age, body type, sense of height, head-to-body ratio, and full-body proportions for each angle. The dress color, polka dot size and spacing, shoulder position, waist position, hem length, and shoe structure should also match.

In the left side of the lower approximately 35%, place a white lined notebook, a black metal pen, a silver paper clip, and a white eraser elegantly as independent small design elements. Do not let the character hold them or draw events with the character.

In the center to the right of the lower row, place the same person's face at three points: front, diagonal 3/4, and profile at the same magnification. Show the same dress as in the upper row at the shoulder. On the far right, place five colors: the wine red of the dress, the ivory of the polka dots, the representative skin and hair colors obtained from the reference image, and metallic silver as a vertical color palette.

[Design and Quality]
The background is white to warm ivory. Use a very thin paper texture, faint lined motifs, thin dividing lines, and sufficient margins to finish in a sophisticated fashion editorial style with the three-view drawings in the upper row as the main focus.

While maintaining the drawing direction of the reference image, clearly draw the face, eyes, hair, fingers, dress outline, polka dots, hem, and shoe straps and buckles. Do not include blurring, low resolution, ambiguous outlines, making the person look different, changes in face/hair/body type/head-to-body ratio per angle, different costumes, residuals of costumes or decorations from the original image, persons other than the six specified displays, extra limbs or fingers, body deformation, long text, dialogue, logos, or watermarks.

The only text in the image should be the three headings "01 FRONT", "02 SIDE", and "03 BACK".
